prompt.initial:
Use case: illustration-story
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, ideally 1536x864 or larger, PNG, for バスケまとめ. This is a new illustration, not a photograph and not a recreation of an actual game.

STYLE: match the approved thumbnail's visual vocabulary: near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B brush slashes, warm ivory Japanese headline typography, bold hand-drawn ink and dry-brush hatching. Very high contrast, expressive sports editorial drawing, minimal elements. Sharp typography, generous safe margins. No photorealism. No official photo pixels, team/league logos, sponsor marks, brand marks, watermarks or jersey lettering.

LAYOUT: left 46% is an uncluttered text block. Right 54% shows TWO real players in a dynamic one-on-one basketball scene; bodies angled and knees bent, with contrasting silhouettes and visible faces. Jake Layman drives forward with one orange basketball controlled in his right hand at hip height, Zack Baranski guards him in an athletic defensive stance. Show heads, torsos, both arms, and enough upper legs to convey movement. Keep the ball, all hands, all faces inside the canvas. Anatomically natural five-fingered hands, no merged arms, no extra limbs. The scene is purely illustrative. Do not show a scoreboard, basket result, winning shot or celebratory victory. Keep small footer clear of figures.

REAL PLAYER LIKENESS based on the official photographs inspected:
1. Jake Layman (Sendai 89ERS): tall, lean white adult man, narrow elongated rectangular face, angular jaw, clean-shaven, straight prominent nose, pale blue eyes, short light-brown/dark-blond hair with a neat side part and lifted swept-back top. No beard. Lime/yellow plain basketball singlet with black edging, no logo, no name, no number.
2. Zack Baranski (Alvark Tokyo): white adult man, sturdier build than Layman, short wavy light-brown hair swept upward/back with trimmed sides, strong eyebrows, deeper-set eyes, fuller angular face, distinct medium full brown beard and moustache. Plain near-black singlet with narrow ivory edging, no logo, no name, no number. Distinguish his beard and face shape clearly from Layman. Both faces must read as individual people in an ink illustration, not generic fictional players.

EXACT TEXT ONLY, spell all Japanese accurately:
small masthead: 「バスケまとめ」
small date: 「2026.11.06」
matchup kicker: 「仙台 × A東京」
large headline on two lines: 「東地区」 and 「首位攻防」
prominent time line: 「今夜 19:05」
small but readable qualifier: 「試合前展望 / 独自予測」
bottom footer, clearly legible: 「イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ」

Hierarchy: 首位攻防 is largest and lime; 東地区 ivory, matchup ivory. Leave breathing room. All text contained safely with at least 4% edge margins. The qualifiers and AI footer must remain legible. Do not add any other text or numerals. In particular no player names, no individual results, no score, no team records, no claim of confirmed player participation. This matchup and time are from the fixed supplied article; player selection is random from the teams' official rosters, so their action is only an image, not reporting of their appearance or achievement.
